name: The Pond
source:
You wander alone along a aged path to the same old pond, but what waits may change your outlook on life? or not. The choice is up to you.

[From [url=https://bonsaipeaches.itch.io/the-pond]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你独自沿着一条古老的小路漫步到同一个古老的池塘，但等待什么会改变你的人生观？或不。选择权取决于你。

[来自[url=https://bonsaipeaches.itch.io/the-pond]itch.io[/url]]
